title: ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF IEEE STUDENTS BRANCH UNIVERSITY OF PERADENIYA 2021

descriptionHtml:
The Annual General Meeting of the IEEE Student Branch Chapter University of Peradeniya was held on 03rd February 2022 through the Zoom platform with the participation of Dr. Ruwan Ranaweera, Senior Lecturer of Electrical and Electronic Engineering Department, University of Peradeniya, and Advisor and Senior Treasurer of the society. Thereby the former members concluded their duties and handed them over to the new office bearers marking the inauguration of the term 2022.

The new office bearers were elected and selected for the year 2022.
Mr. Vanodhya Warnasooriya was selected as the new chairperson, Mr. Rumesh Weerasinghe was selected as the new vice-chair, and Mr. Sachith Wijesooriya as the secretary of the society. The meeting concluded with the hope of continuing a successful year ahead.
